trace.englishDescription: An indication that could be used as the evidence of an incident or thing.

tragic.englishDescription: A story or life being sad, unfortunate, and pitiful.

transcendence.definitionKo: 현상이나 상태 등이 더 높은 수준으로 발전함.
transcendence.englishDescription: The act of developing a phenomenon, state, etc., to a higher level.
The state of exceeding a realistic and normal limit.

transcendence.definitionKo: 이 세상의 평범한 것이나 능력의 한계를 벗어남.
transcendence.englishDescription: An act of exceeding the limitations of a normal object or a normal ability of this world.

translucent.definitionKo: 빛이 또렷하게 통하지 않아 반대쪽이 흐릿하게 보이는 성질이 있다.
translucent.englishDescription: Having a quality of not letting light pass through completely so that things on the opposite side are seen vaguely.

triumpant return.englishDescription: Return after winning a battle or match.

trivial.definitionKo: 중요하지 않은 정도로 아주 작거나 적다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too small or little to be considered significant.

trivial.definitionKo: 말하거나 생각할 거리도 못 될 만큼 하찮다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too trivial to be worthy of being talked or thought about.
So small as to be worthless.

trivial.definitionKo: 여러 가지 일이나 물건 또는 생각이 행동 등이 다 작고 소소하다.
trivial.englishDescription: All of several matters, objects, thoughts, actions, etc., being small and insignificant.
Insignificant because it is small and unimportant.

trivial.definitionKo: 중요하거나 특별할 것이 없어 겨우 하찮은 것밖에 안 되다.
trivial.englishDescription: Being merely something trivial, without anything important or special.

trivial.definitionKo: 시시하고 하찮아서 중요하게 여길 만하지 않다.
trivial.englishDescription: Too small and trivial to be regarded as important.

tug at someone's heart.englishExpression: touch; move; tug at someone's heart

unconventional.englishDescription: Having a unique feature unlike something common.

unconventional.definitionKo: 성격이나 태도 등이 형식에 매이지 않아 꾸밈이나 거짓이 없고 털털하다.
unconventional.englishDescription: One's personality, attitude, etc., being free from formalities and unaffected.
Breaking a fixed form or manner.

undergo pain.englishDescription: To undergo undesirable pain or damage.

undervalue.englishDescription: To be set lower than actual price or value.

unerringly.englishDescription: In a definite way with no doubt.

unfaithful.definitionKo: 부부가 서로에게 충실하지 않고 다른 사람과 바람을 피우다.
unfaithful.englishDescription: Betraying one's spouse and having an affair with another person.

ungenerous.definitionKo: 마음 씀씀이나 태도가 너그럽지 못하고 쌀쌀하다.
ungenerous.englishDescription: One's mind or attitude being cold and not generous.

unhappiness.englishDescription: The state of not being happy.

unhappiness.definitionKo: 운이 없음. 좋지 않은 일을 당함.
unhappiness.englishDescription: Lack of luck, or experiencing undesirable events.

unload.definitionKo: 등에 지거나 차에 실었던 것을 내려놓다.
unload.englishDescription: To discharge a load from one's back or a vehicle.
To unload freight from a ship.

unsparingly.englishDescription: With an attitude of being not stingy with something at all.

use the lead.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 남이 하기 전에 먼저 하다.
use the lead.englishDescription: To do something before someone does it.

vicinity.definitionKo: 어떤 곳을 중심으로 그 곳에서 가까운 곳.
vicinity.englishDescription: An area near a certain place.

vicinity.definitionKo: 어떤 장소나 물건, 사람을 중심으로 하여 가까운 곳.
vicinity.englishDescription: A spot close to a certain place, object, or a person.

vicinity.definitionKo: 어떤 대상의 바로 옆. 또는 아주 가까운 곳.
vicinity.englishDescription: A place next to or very close to someone or something.

virtuous person.englishDescription: A person with good character or personality.

virus.definitionKo: 유행성 감기, 소아마비 등의 감염성 병원체가 되는 아주 작은 미생물.
virus.englishDescription: A microorganism that acts as an infectious agent in influenza, polio, etc.
A program that makes a computer work abnormally.

virus.definitionKo: 사람들을 병에 걸리게 하거나 음식을 썩게 하는 아주 작은 생물.
virus.englishDescription: A very small organism that makes food rot or people sick.

virus.definitionKo: 사람들을 병에 걸리게 하거나 음식을 썩게 하는 아주 작은 생물.
virus.englishDescription: A very small organism that makes people sick or food rot.

vital point.definitionKo: 조금만 다쳐도 매우 위험해질 수 있는 몸의 중요한 부분.
vital point.englishDescription: An important area in one's body where even the smallest injury could threaten one's life.

vocalist.definitionKo: 가곡이나 오페라 같은 음악을 전문적으로 부르는 사람.
vocalist.englishDescription: A person who sings music such as classical songs or opera professionally.

voice box.definitionKo: 소리를 내고 공기를 통하게 하는 목구멍의 한 부분.
voice box.englishDescription: The part of the throat for producing a sound or allowing air to pass.

warehousing.definitionKo: 창고에 물건을 넣음. 또는 새로운 상품이 들어옴.
warehousing.englishDescription: The act of putting goods into a warehouse; the state of new goods having arrived in a store.

waste of time.definitionKo: 어떤 일을 시도했다가 얻은 것이 없이 일을 끝냄. 또는 그렇게 끝낸 일.
waste of time.englishDescription: The act of finishing something without gaining anything from the endeavor, or such an endeavor.

water rises.definitionKo: 나무 뿌리에서 물기가 가지와 잎에 퍼지다.
water rises.englishDescription: For water to spread out from the root of a tree to the branches and leaves.

watery and whitish.englishExpression: watery and whitish; murky and dimly white

well-shaped.englishDescription: Having a good shape and therefore looking good.

western film.definitionKo: 19세기 후반 미국의 서부 개척 시대를 배경으로 개척자와 악당의 대결을 그린 영화나 연극.
western film.englishDescription: A movie or play that features the fight between a pioneer and a villain against the backdrop of the American westerward expansion during the late 19th century.

what the hell.definitionKo: 뒤에 오는 말이 못마땅하여 욕하는 말.
what the hell.englishDescription: An expression used to complain about and show dissatisfaction with something said immediately after the initial statement.

white team.definitionKo: 운동 경기에서 색깔을 써서 양편을 나눌 때, 흰색의 편.
white team.englishDescription: The white side, when dividing teams in colors in sports games.

wholesale market.definitionKo: 물건을 낱개로 팔지 않고 여러 개를 한꺼번에 파는 가게가 모여 있는 시장.
wholesale market.englishDescription: A market where many stores sell a large quantity of the same product, rather than selling them one by one.

why on earth.englishExpression: what on earth; how on earth; why on earth

wide foot.definitionKo: (비유적으로) 많은 사람을 알고 지내며 폭넓게 활동하는 사람.
wide foot.englishDescription: (figurative) A sociable person who knows a lot of people and is very broad in his/her sphere of social activity.

win every battle.definitionKo: 전쟁이나 경기 등에서 한 번도 지지 않고 모두 이기다.
win every battle.englishDescription: To never lose and win every time in war, competition, etc.
win every battle.englishExpression: win every battle; win every match

winning of a prize.definitionKo: 상을 받을 수 있는 등수 안에 듦.
winning of a prize.englishDescription: An act of winning a prize in a competition, etc.

winter vegetables.definitionKo: 채소를 늦가을이나 초겨울에 심는 일. 또는 그 채소.
winter vegetables.englishDescription: The act of planting vegetables in late fall or early winter; or such vegetables.

with a swishing sound.definitionKo: 칼이나 가위로 종이나 천 등을 한 번에 자르는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a swishing sound.englishDescription: A word imitating or describing the sound or movement of cutting a piece of paper, cloth, etc., with a scissor or knife.
with a swishing sound.englishExpression: with a snip; with a swishing sound

annotations: 문장을 이루는 최소 단위로 띄어쓰기의 단위이다.
word segment.englishDescription: Each and every single word segment that makes up a sentence.

wrangle.englishDescription: The act of quarreling with each other.

wrangle.definitionKo: 서로 자신이 옳다고 주장하면서 고집을 부리고 말로 싸우는 일.
wrangle.englishDescription: The act of arguing with each other, while sticking to their own opinion.

wrangle.definitionKo: 서로 자신이 옳다고 주장하면서 고집을 부리고 말로 싸우다.
wrangle.englishDescription: To argue with each other, while sticking to their own opinion.

written apology.definitionKo: 자신의 잘못을 인정하며 용서해 달라고 비는 내용을 적은 글.
written apology.englishDescription: A message written to show that a person admits his/her own fault and to beg for forgiveness.

written vow.definitionKo: 상대방에게 약속을 지키겠다는 내용을 적은 문서.
written vow.englishDescription: A document that contains one's vow to keep a promise to someone.

yahoo.definitionKo: 사람들이 산에 오르면서 서로 부르거나 외치는 소리.
yahoo.englishDescription: A sigh called out when climbing a mountain.

yes vote.definitionKo: 투표에서 어떤 사람이나 안건 등에 찬성하고 따르는 표.
yes vote.englishDescription: A vote cast to agree with or follow a person, agenda, etc.
A vote in favor of something.

yi i.definitionKo: 조선 시대의 정치가이자 학자(1536~1584). 신사임당의 아들이며, 이황과 함께 한국 최고의 성리학자로 꼽힌다.
yi i.englishDescription: A politician and scholar (1536-1584) of the Joseon Dynasty, and the son of Sin Saimdang, a female artist of the time; along with Yi Hwang, he is regarded as one of the most prominent Neo-Confucian scholars in Korea.

annotations: 임금이나 그의 가족과 관련된 명사 뒤에 붙여 쓴다.
your highness.definitionKo: 임금이나 그 가족과 관련된 말 뒤에 붙어 존대의 뜻을 나타내는 말.
your highness.englishDescription: An appellation to respectfully call a king or his family.

your highness.definitionKo: (높이는 말로) 조선 시대에, 다음에 왕이 될 왕세자를 이르거나 부르는 말.
your highness.englishDescription: (polite form) A word used in the Joseon Dynasty of Korea to refer to or address a prince who will inherit the crown.
A word used to refer to or address an emperor or empress with respect.
